messages:
sam: Heads-up: customers are reporting that the flag preview in Console gives different per-tenant caps than what the runtime actually enforces. saw a customer ticket last night.
rita: Yea I noticed that too. Runtime uses live token counts; Console preview uses rollup from telemetry which can be delayed.
chao: We should surface a confidence band in preview (e.g. +/- X%) and show if we used a fallback. Operators shouldn't be surprised.
sam: Agreed. Proposal: backend returns `preview_allocation`, `confidence_score` (0..1), and `confidence_band_pct`. Console shows band visually and a short reason.
rita: For fallback strategy: prefer short-term EWMA of cohort_usage (3d) but if data missing > 30m fall back to historical median and mark confidence low.
chao: I prefer 7d EWMA to avoid overreacting to diurnal swings. maybe EWMA window configurable?
vik: Can we also add a `shadow_preview_run=true` param so Console can request what runtime would actually apply if flag were live (no commit) — basically shadow the routing engine with the preview diffs. That would help detect edge cases.
sam: Shadow runs are heavy but useful. Maybe limit to 1 request per minute per user and sample tenants. Good for debug.
rita: API sketch: GET /config/flag_preview?flag_id=F123&window=3d&shadow=true&include_confidence=true
chao: Backend implementation notes: compute cohort_usage = sum(last_samples) if missing -> EWMA(days=7, alpha=0.15) -> confidence = f(samples_count, freshness) -> band = 1 - confidence. Also emit metric `flag_preview_confidence_gauge` and `preview_shadow_mismatch_rate`.
vik: For rollout: feature flag `ui.preview_confidence_v2` off by default. Canary to 5% orgs then 25%. watch `preview_shadow_mismatch_rate` and `customer_ticket_rate` tag=preview.
sam: UX: show a small inline pill: "Confidence: Low (0.28)" with hover explaining calculation + link to docs and link to "Request shadow run" when available.
rita: Tests: unit tests for EWMA math, integration test mocking telemetry gaps, and a smoke e2e that flips `ui.preview_confidence_v2` and checks UI pill appears.
chao: One more: if confidence < 0.2, Console should annotate each tenant row with "expected allocation uncertain" and provide ability to export CSV for ops investigation.
vik: ops-bot can you add the canary plan and monitoring alerts for `preview_shadow_mismatch_rate > 0.05` and `flag_preview_confidence_gauge < 0.2` for more than 15m?
deploy-bot: Canary schedule created: preview-confidence-v2 roll -> 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z -> groups: 5pctl initial. Notes: monitoring alerts queued.
sam: ok owners: @rita backend (preview service), @chao routing/shadow, @vik console. I'll own the release notes.
rita: putting up the backend PR tonight. ETA for canary: next Thu.
chao: I'll land shadow-run infra but gate to internal-only for first rollout.
vik: I'll add the UI pill and a small doc page.
sam: thanks team, lets reconvene after canary metrics come in.
notes: thread discussing preview/runtime allocation mismatch, confidence scoring, EWMA fallback, shadow run API, UI pill, tests, canary plan
